meta.title: Apply to foster
meta.description: Apply to foster a cat with Happy Paws Cat Rescue. Tell us about your home and we will be in touch.

s1.p: Tell us a little about your home and we will be in touch. Foster homes give our cats a safe, calm place to wait for their forever home.
s1.p2: Want to know more first? [Read about fostering](/foster/) or [ask us a question](/contact/).

form.intro: If you would like to help us by fostering, please fill in the form. We would love to talk to you.
steps: You tell us a little about your home.
We chat, and get to know you.
You meet your first foster cat.
